notes.title: Dream On — last update
notes.content: [p][b]Hey friends![/b][/p][p]I’d like to share a small final update for this game.[/p][p][/p][p]To be honest, I didn’t expect so many people to play it. Because of that, a few parts were left a bit rough around the edges. But thanks to your support, now i feel inspired to polish things up.[/p][p][/p][p]There won’t be many changes — just a couple of small ones — but I hope you’ll enjoy them.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, it’s time for me to move on to the next game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for being part of this journey.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598195/801c6828c4c8129cc371942b9328f14b4f5589ae.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Dream On Update — Thank You for Your Support!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

First of all, I want to say a huge thank you to everyone who played Dream On and left a review. Your support truly means the world to me and keeps me motivated to create more.

Based on your feedback, I’ve made a few small but meaningful updates:

🔇 Glitch/Noise Warning — There’s now a disclaimer at the beginning of the game about possible glitchy visual/audio effects. I’ve also toned down the noise to avoid jump scares.

🕹️ New Interactions — I won’t spoil the surprise, but there are a few new things to discover in this version!

🏆 Steam Achievements — A few achievements have been added! There aren't many, but I hope you’ll enjoy finding them all.

If you’d like to follow my dev journey and behind-the-scenes content, feel free to check out my [url=https://bsky.app/profile/alice-icek.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], where I post gifs and development progress.

Once again, thank you so much for your support 💜
